- `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`:

    - the inspector's 源码 / 属性 tabs go (`inspectorTab`, `:3216`, `:4591`);
    - one status line sits above the canvas;
    - the item's definition is reachable from the item header's ⋯ menu (查看定义 · 复制 JSON · 重命名 · 删除 as the card draws it, reusing whatever rename and delete the header already offers).
  - The pillar labels from 1024 px up (item 6: `sr-only xl:not-sr-only` → `lg:`, `:1787`).
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioAiCopilot.tsx` and `packages/app-shell/src/layout/ChatDock.tsx`, only as far as the copilot moves into the shared slot and gains its folded strip. The ChatDock's other hosts keep their behaviour.
- The new copy goes in the designer table (`metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, en and zh rows).
- Tests beside the existing `StudioDesignSurface.*` and `StudioAiCopilot.*` families.
- One `.changeset/12725-*.md` for `@object-ui/app-shell`.

Not this claim; the card stays open for them, `Part of #12725` (they need the copilot's draft provenance and objectstack-ai/cloud#2924's payload, which this seat cannot read):
- item 3's 草稿 chip and 来源 line on a copilot-changed setting;
- item 4, change card v2;
- item 5, the 变更 badge counting the copilot's drafts as they land.

The PR carries `Part of #12725`, not `Fixes`. On merge the seat releases the card back to `pm:queue` with these items named.

Outside the surface:
- the copilot's conversation, agent and request paths;
- the console's own ChatDock hosts;
- every other pillar's editors;
- objectui#12724's AI build cards.

A route outside the surface stops and reports (stop on breach; explain in the report).
Container & model: `L`, `mode:cloud`, `model: opus` (default tier; no path-derived mandate; sized L for an 8.5k-line surface file and two hosts)
Clause-②: no
Clause-② reason: Studio's own chrome is rearranged. No spec key, exported prop, export or language-pack key changes; the new copy goes in the metadata-admin designer table, and `StudioDesignSurface` / `StudioChatDock` keep their exported signatures.
Responsibility: n/a — a ruled design change (the maintainer's 「按「右栏二选一」定稿」, quoted in the card)
Thread-read: none
Serial constraints cleared: read at objectui `main` `4b3d6ed`. No open non-bot PR exists, and the bot PRs touch no source file. The in-flight `domain:ui` cards held by other seats (objectui#12843, #12816, #12809, #12795) name console Home, the Approvals inbox, the splash and the console sidebar, not Studio's design surface or the ChatDock. The last changes to `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` are this seat's PR #12849 (objectui#12718) and PR #12792 (objectui#12707), both merged. The seat holds no other card in flight (serial mode; objectui#12726 was released to `pm:retriage` as a duplicate of objectui#11815).
